find_MJCF_element_by_namespace: find an MJCF element by namespace and identifier in the object tree
find_all_MJCF_elements: find all MJCF elements of a given namespace in the model hierarchy
add_child_MJCF_element: add a new child element with attributes to an MJCF parent element
generate_MJCF_xml_string: generate a pretty-printed XML string from an MJCF element tree
compare_MJCF_elements: check whether two MJCF elements are semantically equivalent using is_same_as
